name: Learn
overview: Scripture calls believers to a deliberate and humble pursuit of wisdom through learning. Psalms 90:12 emphasizes the importance of understanding the brevity of life to cultivate wisdom in our hearts. Proverbs 3:1 urges us to hold fast to God's commandments as the foundation for growth, while Matthew 11:29 invites us to learn directly from Christ’s meek and lowly heart, promising true rest for our souls. Together, these verses highlight learning as an active, heart-centered process rooted in God’s truth and the example of Jesus.
